profile_name: Doctoral Researcher (PhD) in Machine Learning - Faculty of EECS, Universitaet Alt-Moabit (case study)

company.name: Universitaet Alt-Moabit, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
company.summary: A public research university in Berlin. The Machine Learning group at the faculty conducts research in the design, development, and analysis of novel data mining and machine learning methods, from statistical learning theory to applied research with interdisciplinary partners in medicine and mobility.
company.values_text: scientific integrity; academic excellence; open science; interdisciplinary collaboration; responsible supervision and teaching

job.title: Doctoral Researcher (PhD) in Machine Learning
job.description: You will pursue a doctorate within the Machine Learning group: designing, developing, and analyzing novel machine learning methods, publishing in peer-reviewed venues, contributing to interdisciplinary projects, and assisting in teaching. The eligibility criteria for this position follow the published standard of comparable Berlin ML groups: a Master's degree in computer science, physics, or a related field; proven programming experience; and excellent communication skills.
